title: Unary copying step
statement: Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and choose distinct work-tape indices $s,t\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$. Let $c$ indicate whether copying is enabled, and let $d$ be a configuration with $m$ Boolean work tapes. For a Boolean word $w$ and an integer $r<|w|$, suppose tape $s$ in $d$ contains the symbol $w_r$ at the cell $r$ positions to the right of its head. Form a configuration from $d$ by setting its phase to unary, advancing the heads on tape $s$ and, when copying is enabled, tape $t$ by $r$, and placing the first $r$ symbols of $w$ on tape $t$ starting at its original head position when copying is enabled. One step of the machine so defined produces the configuration formed in the same way with $r+1$ in place of $r$, and with phase unary if $w_r$ is true and done otherwise.
